content.subject: Automating month end close at Payouts Network
content.draft_text:
Hi Jon,
Your CFO appointment notes experience guiding companies through IPOs.
That suggests month end close may still rely on manual matching across systems, adding latency and risk to financial reporting.
We build a connector that reconciles transactions between your ERP and payment platform, eliminating manual effort and errors.
Do you have 15 minutes next week to discuss the idea?
Zamp
